lead: Aviation software competitors expanded EFB, flight planning, and AI-driven platforms through recent customer adoptions and product releases, though explicit low-cost carrier concentration remains unverified by the data.

insights.title: Vendor-specific IFS EFB wins across regional and freight carriers
insights.finding: IFS secured multiple EFBOne platform selections and deployments, including fastjet across its Embraer 145 fleet, TUS Airways for its Airbus A320 fleet, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is classified as a low-cost carrier, while TUS Airways and MY FREIGHTER operate regional/charter or cargo services.
insights.caveat: Explicit LCC adoption concentration cannot be formally asserted solely from these wins.

insights.title: Jeppesen and competitors introduce AI and automated flight planning capabilities
insights.finding: Jeppesen introduced initial artificial intelligence agents for its ForeFlight Airflow platform and released Dispatch v2026-2 with automated planning workflows.
insights.caveat: Teasers or planned agent roadmaps do not confirm full operational deployment of all features.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems expands Lido Flight 4D and mPilot deployments
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems deployed Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways and integrated the iOS-based Lido mPilot EFB solution for Viva.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways is a full-service carrier, while Viva operates as a low-cost carrier.
insights.caveat: Evidence is limited to individual implementation announcements.

insights.title: Navblue and Airbus integrate digital portfolios following structural reorganization
insights.finding: Navblue merged with Skywise digital solutions into a consolidated subsidiary, subsequently supporting Skywise Digital Suite adoptions for TransNusa and Pan American World Airways.
insights.caveat: Historical context on Pan American World Airways and TransNusa operational scopes is constrained by source text.

insights.title: Aviobook and Bytron Skybook release functional updates for EFB modules
insights.finding: Aviobook launched AvioBook 26.3 with customizable seat swap confirmations and added a dedicated airline notice section to NOTAMs, while Bytron Skybook released skybook 1.52.0 for its EFB and Ground Portal.
insights.caveat: Customer impact and adoption rates for these specific module updates are not reported in the sources.

caveat: AI-generated synthesis of captured public signals; verify cited sources before making decisions.
